title: Ag-W QSGS v5 precondition trial ledger

trials.name: normal_shift_raw_mask_half_gap_1.35A
trials.reason: The signed-normal displacement alone did not preserve either phase lattice.

trials.name: normal_shift_raw_mask_smoothed_normals
trials.reason: Smoothing the normal field alone did not resolve phase overlap or lattice collapse.

trials.name: smoothed_mask_half_gap_1.35A
trials.reason: The regularized QSGS mask met composition and connectivity checks, but local-normal shifts collapsed same-phase neighbor distances.

trials.name: smoothed_mask_half_gap_0.4A
trials.reason: Reducing the signed-normal shift relieved but did not resolve atomic overlaps.

trials.name: harmonic_same_phase_bonds_with_cross_softcore
trials.result: The LAMMPS trial stopped before output. Logs reported a short communication cutoff and inconsistent periodic image flags for explicit bonds crossing x/y seams.

trials.name: same_phase_morse_with_fixed_bottom_and_cross_softcore
trials.reason: Fixing the bottom layer during geometry construction left severe overlaps in that region.

trials.name: same_phase_morse_all_mobile_no_screen_cutoffs
trials.reason: Releasing all atoms preserved phase connectivity and cleared cross-phase contacts, but many W-W distances remained short.

trials.name: same_phase_morse_high_curvature
trials.reason: The high-curvature temporary potential drove atoms through the z wall and LAMMPS aborted.

trials.name: same_phase_morse_with_frozen_distance_screen_cutoffs
trials.reason: The first full precondition run retained some cross and W-W short contacts.

trials.name: screenbuffer_pair_precondition
trials.reason: This was the best temporary-precondition candidate. Seven W-W pairs remained slightly below the frozen screen, so it was not a geometry pass.

trials.name: spring_free_dai_efs_minimize_without_fixed_bottom
trials.reason: LAMMPS lost one atom by step 1600 before writing a minimized structure.

trials.name: spring_free_dai_efs_minimize_with_fixed_bottom
trials.reason: The minimizer reached its 10000-step cap. The EFS-relaxed structure had severe short contacts and atoms above z=200 A.
